sheetsIndicative.note: one worksheet ('Amateur Callsgn 11092025'): header Callsign,Product__c,Status,Type,Licence LastModifiedDate,Licence Original_start_date__c then 158,470 data rows - a Salesforce-flavoured shape carrying the source system's own object/field names. Status vocabulary Allocated (105,631), Reserved (52,291), Available (534) and blank (14); Type is 'Call Sign - Amateur' on every row. Product__c carries the licence product (Full 61,393, Foundation 37,656, Intermediate 14,736, Club 2,147, Temporary Reciprocal 123) with 42,415 blank. Licence LastModifiedDate and Licence Original_start_date__c are each populated on 105,519 rows (last-modified 2020-10-15 to 2025-09-11; original-start 1903-05-03 to 2025-09-11) and blank on 52,951.

raw-extract-sheet-1-amateur-callsgn-1109.contentsIndicative: mechanical extract of the single sheet; header Callsign,Product__c,Status,Type,Licence LastModifiedDate,Licence Original_start_date__c then 158,470 rows. Dates arrive typed and are rendered ISO (date-only). Anomalies preserved verbatim: two Callsigns are lower-case (g0jrk, 2e1GTD); 'G6 FMU' and reciprocal 'M/TKG 2021' have interior spaces; three carry a trailing non-breaking space (2E1HON, G7IWE, G0TQK); one is literally '.'; two are full English words (EDUCATIONAL, ENVIRONMENTS, both Full/Allocated); 481 four-character and 148 six-to-twelve-character Callsigns appear, most of them reciprocal 'M/...' forms including curiosities such as M/#YO3IES, M/#VK4VGK and M/M/PT2FM.

normalised--sheet-1-amateur-callsgn-1109.contentsIndicative: header callsign,status,licence_class,last_modified_date,original_start_date; 158,470 rows sorted by callsign. Status carried verbatim (Allocated/Reserved/Available and 14 blanks preserved); licence_class is the source Product__c verbatim (42,415 blanks preserved); both dates carried as ISO from the typed workbook (each blank on 52,951 rows). The constant Type column is required-present but not carried. The trailing-non-breaking-space trio (2E1HON, G7IWE, G0TQK) is trimmed - the only canonicalisation applied - and counted in the converter notes, never silent; because G0TQK and G7IWE each also appear as a bare-callsign row, those two collapse onto duplicate callsign keys here (an honest consequence of trimming, preserved), while 2E1HON's non-breaking-space form is unique. Lower-case forms, the interior-space 'G6 FMU'/'M/TKG 2021', the '.' value and the EDUCATIONAL/ENVIRONMENTS words are preserved verbatim.
